text_blocks.snippet: Symptoms of thyroid cancer may include:

list.snippet: A lump or nodule in the neck: This is the most common symptom.
Enlarged thyroid gland: The thyroid may feel like a hard mass or knot in the front of the neck.
Hoarseness or changes in voice: This can occur due to pressure on the vocal cords.
Persistent cough: Irritation of the throat by the tumor can cause a cough.
Shortness of breath: This may be caused by pressure on the windpipe.
Difficulty swallowing: This can occur if the tumor presses on the esophagus.
Weight loss or gain: Thyroid cancer can affect metabolism.
Increased sensitivity to heat or cold: This can be a sign of an overactive thyroid gland.
Bone pain: In advanced cases, thyroid cancer can spread to the bones.
Flushing: This is a rare symptom that can occur with medullary thyroid cancer.
